author: rsi_demo
title: G13 · 拒绝
body:
Generation 13 keeps the five proven champion kernels unchanged and targets three
measurable sources of avoidable work: word-frequency counting now uses mutable
count holders and a k-element selection heap instead of repeatedly setting
counts and sorting the whole vocabulary, LIS uses a typed-array tail buffer
with an append fast path and a constant-time descending-sequence exit, and
interval merging avoids copying every input pair while retaining ascending
touching semantics. These changes are independent, preserve argument purity
and exact ordering, and should provide enough headroom over the 47.2294x
champion to clear the 49.5909x acceptance threshold.
